claim_one_line: THE OBJECT'S MIRROR ON THE TWO-FACE E6 IS SPLIT. The amphichirality of A = LR is conjugation by P = diag(1,-1) (R -> R^-1, L -> L^-1); mod 5 it is INNER on 2I = SL(2,F5) (det P = -1 = 2^2 is a square): conjugation by diag(3,2), of order 4, whose icosian image h inverts R_q and L_q; the representative h' = L_q h sends the founding ratio g to g^-1 exactly and so preserves Z[g] and E6 = Z[g]^perp. On E6 the mirror Ad(h') is OUTER (the six 27 classes go to 27bar classes), fixes 6 roots (3A1) with 33 two-orbits, and has Cartan signature fixed 3 / odd 3; quaternion conjugation (B1270's 'theta', corrected here: it is the inversion, not the mirror -- E69) is outer with signature 1/5; their ratio is inner with signature 4/2 (12 fixed roots, A3). LEMMA: the odd part of a stable Cartan under a Cartan involution is an abelian subspace of p, so dim(odd) <= real rank; real ranks E6(-78) 0, E6(-26) 2, E6(-14) 2, E6(2) 4, E6(6) 6. Hence the mirror is the Cartan involution of E6(6), the SPLIT form (k = sp(8)), and NOT of E6(-26) (real rank 2 < 3): theta does not cross the fork (THE_STATE section 7 item 2 answered on the lattice; B1265-main's doubt confirmed for a computed reason; B1119's 'mirror swap -> E6(6) split' agrees from the Lorentz-double side). B576's f4 + 26 grading is the involution commuting with the principal sl2 -- E6(-26)'s, in the representation frame; the two frames' 'theta on E6' differ, and their identification is I-25's unearned embedding. THE TRIPLE: of the 27 SO(10) x U(1) gradings of a 27 (one per weight), exactly 3 commute with the mirror, and they are mutually orthogonal with E6 parts summing to zero -- one of the cubic's 45 zero-sum triples, i.e. the SO(8) x U(1)^2 triality frame of E6 (27 = 8v + 8s + 8c + 1 + 1 + 1); 15 of 27 commute with the inversion, 7 with the ratio. THE SL2 FENCE: among 104 mirror endomorphisms of pi_1(m004) with rho o alpha ~ rhobar (words <= 6, exact over Q(omega)) none is involutive on the nose (44 have alpha^2 inner, 60 have alpha^2 = Ad(D) with D outside the image), so the mirror's real type on the object's own sl(2,C) (sl(2,R) vs su(2)) is left open.
